summary: Hooker Furnishings Corp filed an 8-K announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $0.115 per share declared by its board on June 9, 2026, payable June 30, 2026, to holders of record June 19, 2026. This is a routine capital return event; no other special-situation activity is disclosed. The filing includes only the dividend declaration and a press release.
